## Standards

No hard violation of `CLAUDE.md` was found; Reviewer Soul remains free of the new schema/runtime mechanics, and no permanent adjudication probes were added.

- **Judgement call — possible Divergent Change:** `src/reviewer-dispatch.ts:283-561` combines Git pin/range/material I/O with capability parsing, prompt compilation, and acceptance lifecycle. Relevant hunks include `createReviewerPinnedGitReader(...)` and `createReviewerDispatcher(...)`. These concerns will change for different reasons; move pinned Git reading into its own module while retaining dispatch as the capability/compiler/transition owner.

- **Judgement call — possible Duplicated Code:** `src/reviewer-dispatch.ts:77-97` defines `AcceptedReviewerLeg`/`AcceptedReviewerDispatch`, while `src/reviewer-execution-ledger.ts:20-40` repeats nearly the same structures as `ReviewerCompiledLegEvidence`/`ReviewerAcceptedEvidence`:
  > `axis: "standards" | "spec";`  
  > `prompt: ReviewerPromptIdentity["bytes"];`  
  > `grant: ReviewerCapabilityRequest;`

  Derive the projected evidence types from the accepted dispatch types so their shapes cannot drift.

- **Judgement call — possible Mysterious Name:** throughout `test/reviewer-role.test.ts`, especially lines 48 and 56:
  > `const h=setup(); ... const ctx={} as ExtensionContext;`

  `h` does not reveal that it is the Reviewer harness. The same file already uses the clearer `reviewerHarness`; use that naming consistently.

No repository probe changes were made during this review.

## Spec

1. **P1 — Failure-retention evidence is incorrect (`src/reviewer-agent.ts:491-506`).** The Plan requires preserving “**cancellation/failure retention**” and recording actual “**workspace dispositions**.” `prepareWorkspace()` creates and retains a temporary workspace on setup failure, attaching its path to the thrown error. However, because assignment to `workspace` never completes, the outer catch at line 506 records `"not-created"` and discards that retained path. The snapshot failure path similarly replaces retained mirror evidence with `"not-created"` at line 494. Failed setup therefore leaks retained directories while the durable ledger falsely reports that none were created. This requirement is only partially implemented and the resulting evidence is wrong.

No additional scope creep was identified.

Inspection was against pinned target `bbffa3ab6bacafad05dc43fe2062434e80dd46a5`. No product or probe changes were made; tool-generated scratch remained outside the review clone.

**Summary:** Standards: 3 judgement-call findings; worst is possible Divergent Change in `src/reviewer-dispatch.ts`. Spec: 1 finding; worst is P1 incorrect failure-retention evidence in `src/reviewer-agent.ts`.
